import sys
import math

def ms(s, n):
    for i in range(len(s)):
        s[i] = n

def bitcount(x):
    return bin(x).count('1')

def transform_array(arr, size, mod, invert):
    log_size = size.bit_length() - 1
    for i in range(log_size):
        for mask in range(size):
            if mask & (1 << i):
                prev_mask = mask ^ (1 << i)
                if not invert:
                    arr[mask] = (arr[mask] + arr[prev_mask]) % mod
                else:
                    arr[mask] = (arr[mask] - arr[prev_mask] + mod) % mod

def fast_power_convolution(a, k, p):
    n = len(a)
    if k == 1:
        return a
    if k % 2 == 1:
        temp = fast_power_convolution(a, k - 1, p)
        res = [0] * n
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n - i):
                res[i + j] = (res[i + j] + temp[i] * a[j]) % p
        return res
    else:
        half = fast_power_convolution(a, k // 2, p)
        res = [0] * n
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n - i):
                res[i + j] = (res[i + j] + half[i] * half[j]) % p
        return res

def subset_power(a, k, p):
    LOGN = 19
    n = len(a)
    while n & (n - 1):
        n += 1
    fa = [[0] * n for _ in range(LOGN)]
    fc = [[0] * n for _ in range(LOGN)]
    for i in range(LOGN):
        for j in range(n):
            fa[i][j] = a[j] if j < len(a) else 0
        transform_array(fa[i], n, p, False)
    for i in range(n):
        v = [fa[j][i] for j in range(LOGN)]
        v = fast_power_convolution(v, k, p)
        for j in range(LOGN):
            fc[j][i] = v[j]
    for i in range(LOGN):
        transform_array(fc[i], n, p, True)
    result = [0] * n
    for j in range(n):
        c = bitcount(j)
        if c < LOGN and j < len(a):
            result[j] = fc[c][j]
    return result

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    n, k, p = map(int, input[:3])
    n_input = n
    n_mask = 0
    for i in range(20):
        if (n_input >> i) & 1:
            n_mask |= (1 << i)
    f = [0] * (n_mask + 1)
    for i in range(n_mask + 1):
        t = 0
        for j in range(20):
            if (n_input >> j) & 1:
                t <<= 1
                t |= (i >> j) & 1
        f[t] = i
    if n_input & 1:
        print(pow(k, n_input, p))
        return
    MAXN = 10**6 + 5
    factorial = [1] * MAXN
    for i in range(1, MAXN):
        factorial[i] = (factorial[i - 1] * i) % p
    invFactorial = [1] * MAXN
    invFactorial[MAXN - 1] = pow(factorial[MAXN - 1], p - 2, p)
    for i in range(MAXN - 2, -1, -1):
        invFactorial[i] = (invFactorial[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % p
    a = [0] * (n_mask + 1)
    for i in range(n_mask + 1):
        a[i] = invFactorial[f[i]]
    res = pow(k, n_input, p)
    a = subset_power(a, k, p)
    subtractVal = (a[n_mask] * factorial[n_input]) % p
    res = (res - subtractVal + p) % p
    print(res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
